pending_commit.commit_message: CRAS: system_state - Flag for bluetooth wideband speech enabling We're adding HFP wideband speech mode support, but will not enable it until PLC(packet loss concealment) is well implemented. To allow this feature be tested, add a flag in system state and use cras_test_cilent to toggle it. Example usage: 1. cras_test_client --set_wbs_enabled 1 2. Connect Bose QC35 II headset, WBS will be used. 3. cras_test_client --set_wbs_enabled 0 4. Disconnect and then reconnect Bose QC35 II headset, WBS will not be used. BUG=chromium:843048 TEST=Apply full patch set, execute command cras_test_client --set_wbs_enabled 1 (or 0) to enable and disable wideband mode while manual test Bose QC35 II Change-Id: I21402a999824656ff5a3e6e6f1ac994bab14c449 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1611701 Commit-Ready: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: En-Shuo Hsu <enshuo@google.com>

CRAS: hfp_slc - Clean up HFP features bitmap - Update the HF and AG feature bits definition to HFP 1.7.1 The new codec negotiation feature will be used for WBS. - Move HF/AG features definition to slc header, where the AT commands are implemented and actually using these feature bits. - Let cras_hfp_ag pass in the supported features bitmap when creating an SLC handle. This helps to decouple SLC implementation and the logic deciding whether WBS is supported. BUG=chromium:843048 TEST=Apply full patch set, execute command cras_test_client --set_wbs_enabled 1 (or 0) to enable and disable wideband mode while manual test Bose QC35 II Change-Id: I825d82ea0966b0825b8fa5aa90d9ef301bad0277 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1632050 Commit-Ready: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: En-Shuo Hsu <enshuo@google.com>

CRAS: hfp_slc - Implement codec negotiation This change implements more AT commands defined in HFP service level connection relate to codec negotiation, including: AT+BAC for available codecs handling AT+BCS for codec selection This codec negotiation capability is exposed behind the 'enable_wbs' flag when SLC is created. This allows CrOS host to communicate with headset to use better quality mSBC codec for wideband speech mode in HFP. BUG=chromium:843048 TEST=Apply full patch set, manual test with QC Bose35 II headset. Use cras_test_client --dump_bt to inspect the communication betweeh host and headset. Change-Id: I9239e22a01a4121ab06406fb40fa8859b8bbc5cb Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1362733 Commit-Ready: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: En-Shuo Hsu <enshuo@google.com>

arc: networkd: SO_REUSEADDR needed for adb-proxy on localhost. This patch sets the SO_REUSEADDR on the listening socket so it can be reused. If adb is connected through the proxy and the user logs out then when they log back in, adb-proxy will not be able to rebind and adb is unusable until the server is killed and ARC++ is cycled again. BUG=None TEST=verified manually Change-Id: Icf99df19e958ec404180af0f517d746d11499de3 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1634889 Commit-Ready: Garrick Evans <garrick@chromium.org> Tested-by: Garrick Evans <garrick@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hugo Benichi <hugobenichi@google.com>

CHROMIUM: cpufreq: set cpu min frequency through complex-usb-min-frequency property in rk3288 platform when use some tpye of usb speaker it request cpu frequency larger than 1.2Ghz, so we get the min frequency from complex-usb-min-frequency property, and update cpu frequency policy when we need it, note: if thermal throttling, and complex-usb-min-frequency larger than throtting frequency, we will use throttling frquency as minimum frequency. BUG=chromium:941638 TEST=on mickey board, plug in usb speaker, run command: cat /sys/device/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_min_freq get result: 1200000 if temperature over 82C, get the result:816000 Change-Id: I4d2111f93aa71a33f9a193be3592d0225ab1dffe Signed-off-by: Lin Huang <hl@rock-chips.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/303300 Reviewed-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> (cherry picked from commit b0a35a3f72c38a979e1efa2c167f461c37466a29) [dianders: re-jiggered to support 4.19] Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1635440 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: HACK: sound: usb: fix rk3288 usbspeaker play music staccato issue When connect the usb speaker with hub to play music, the cpu frequency may drop to 126M, the ddr frequency may scaling(which will hold the cpus 500us), all of these may cause staccato music. To avoid that, we set cpu scaling_min_freq to specific value(which define in dts) and disable dmc when detect usb speaker plug in. BUG=chromium:941638 TEST=connect usb speaker with hub, play music, it work normally Change-Id: I9153a48537d3a3a00f9c64252108b587725d34aa Signed-off-by: Lin Huang <hl@rock-chips.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/302392 Reviewed-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> (cherry picked from commit c6194ac24ddc7730bdaa0cea325d57b43a6ea68c) [dianders: re-jiggered to support 4.19] Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1635441 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org>
